meta.homeTitle: Screenshot (App) Maker — Sawirada App Store-ka, oo si fudud loo sameeyo
meta.homeDescription: Sameyso sawirada App Store-ka oo tayo leh, kuna diyaari gudbinta, isticmaalna Ollama si aad si fudud ugu soo saarto noocyada afafka kale lagu turjumay.
meta.ollamaDescription: Ku xir Screenshot (App) Maker server-kaaga Ollama si aad u hesho turjumaada sawirada oo AI ku shaqaynaysa laguna ilaalinayo sirta.
meta.privacyDescription: Baro sida Screenshot (App) Maker u ilaalinayo sirta sawiradaada, wax-ka-beddelkaaga, iyo hannaanka turjumaada.

language.title: Dooro luqad
language.hint: Dooro luqadda kuugu habboon. Magacyada alaabta iyo awaamiirta farsamada ma isbeddelayaan.

hero.eyebrow: Waxaa loo dhisay wejiga ugu dambeeya ka hor daah-furka
hero.titleHtml: U beddel shaashadaha app-ka sawirrada (screenshots) diyaarka u ah gudbinta.
hero.description: Naqshadeey sawir kasta oo uu u baahan yahay gudbinta app-kaaga, ka dibna ku xir Ollama si aad u abuurto noocyo luqado kala duwan leh—adiga oo aan mid walba gacanta ku dib u samayn.

proof.title: Hal goob oo shaqo oo muuqaal ah
proof.body: Laga bilaabo shaashadaha cayriin ilaa agabka lagu sifeeyay

proof.title: Hal naqshad, luuqad kasta
proof.body: Ku turjum qoraalka sawirrada shaashadda adigoo isticmaalaya Ollama

features.titleHtml:
Waqtiga diyaarinta yaree.
Si kalsooni leh u soo saar.
features.description: Screenshot (App) Maker waxay shaqada soo noqnoqota ee dhamaadka soo saarista app-ka u beddeshaa hab shaqo oo muuqaal ah oo cad.

cards.title: Ku soo tuur shaashadaha app-kaaga.
cards.body: Soo geli screenshots-ka, ku qabo qaababka qalabka ee hagaagsan, oo dhowr daqiiqo gudahood ku habeey sheeko dhammaystiran oo Apple App Store ah.

cards.title: Hal mar naqshadeey.
cards.body: Ku dabaq midabada, qaababka, habaynta qalabka, nooca farta, iyo hooska bog kasta, adigoo ilaalinaya in farriin kasta ay tahay mid gaar ah.

cards.title: Ku habee shaashad kasta.
cards.body: Diyaari agabka iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple TV, iyo garaafyada muhiimka ah adigoo isticmaalaya mashruuc isku mid ah.

cards.title: Soo saar xirmo diyaar u ah gudbinta.
cards.body: Sameey sawirro tayo sare leh, nidaami faylalka maxalliga ah, oo isku xir xogta Apple App Store ee turjuman hal kayd oo nadiif ah.

localization.title: Ololahaaga sawirrada shaashadda, oo diyaar u ah suuq kasta.
localization.description: Ku xir Screenshot (App) Maker Ollama, oo turjum cinwaannada sawirrada shaashadda iyo metadata-ka App Store ee isla habka shaqada. Qaabkaaga asalka ah wuxuu ahaanayaa sidii uu ahaa halka qoraalku uu isbeddelayo luqad kasta.
checks: Turjum dhammaan cinwaannada sawirrada shaashadda si koox ah
Ku turjum luqadaha maxalliga ah sharraxaadaha, ereyada muhiimka ah, iyo qoraallada soo saarista
Dib u eeg turjumaadaha ka hor dhoofinta ugu dambaysa
localization.completeBody: Nuqulka iyo metadata-du waxay diyaar u yihiin dib-u-eegis

workflow.title: Geli shaashadaha cayriin. Soo saar hantida diyaarka u ah Store-ka.
workflow.description: Ma jirto habayn naqshad oo adag. Ma jirto baahi lagu dib-u-sameeyo ololaha isku midka ah luqad kasta.

steps.title: Soo geli
steps.body: Ku dar shaashadaha sida ugu wanaagsan u sheegaya sheekada app-kaaga.

steps.title: Naqshadayn & turjumid
steps.body: Halkii mar dhis muuqaalka, ka dibna qoraalkaaga ku turjun Ollama.

steps.title: Dhoofi
steps.body: Soo deji sawirrada iyo metadata-da habaysan, kuwaas oo diyaar u ah gudbinta.

privacy.title: Hantida app-kaaga waxay ku nagaanaynaa gacantaada.
privacy.description: Habaynta screenshot-yada waxay ka dhacaysaa qalabkaaga. Markaad doorato Ollama, qoraalka waxaa loo diraa oo kaliya cinwaanka server-ka aad habaysay.

final.title: Ka dhig tallaabada ugu dambaysa mid fudud.
final.description: Naqshadeey, u turjum luuqadaha, oo dhoofiyo sawir kasta (screenshot) ee ay u baahan tahay soo saarista app-kaaga xigta.
final.action: Ka soo degso Apple App Store

ollama.title: Hagaha Habaynta Ollama
ollama.subtitle: Ku xir Screenshot (App) Maker nuqulkaaga Ollama si aad u hesho turjumaada AI iyo soo saarista qoraalka.
requirements: Kumbuyuutar Mac, Windows PC, ama Linux si loo kiciyo Ollama
iPhone-kaaga/iPad-kaaga oo ku jira shabakadda isku midka ah ee qalabka Ollama (lagu taliyo)
steps: Ku rakib Ollama: soo dejiso oo ku rakib Ollama OS-kaaga.
Bilow Ollama: socodsii ollama serve (ama fura app-ka Ollama ee macOS).
Soo jiid moodal: socodsii ollama pull llama3.2 (ama moodalka aad doorbidayso).
Xaqiiji inuu shaqaynayo: socodsii ollama run llama3.2 oo tijaabi prompt.
Raadi cinwaanka server-kaaga: qoro LAN IP-ga kombiyuutarkaaga (tusaale ahaan 192.168.0.10).
Ku isticmaal app-ka: qaybta settings-ka ee Screenshot (App) Maker, u dejiso Host-ka http://<LAN-IP>:11434.
notes: Haddii app-ku waayo xiriirka, hubi in taleefankaaga iyo kombiyuutarkaagu ay ku jiraan isku shabakadda Wi‑Fi.
Hubi in port-ka 11434 loo oggolaaday firewall-kaaga.
Haddii aad doorbidayso inaad isticmaasho server fog (PC-ga guriga, VPS), waa inaad port-ka u furtaa si ammaan ah (waxaa lagula talinayaa VPN).
ollama.ctaBody: Ku noqo app-ka, tijaabi xiriirka, oo ku bilow hal luqad (locale).

privacy.title: Siyaasadda Qarsoodiga
privacy.intro: Siyaasaddan Qarsoodiga ah waxay sharraxaysaa sida Screenshot (App) Maker ("App-ka") uu u maareeyo xogta isticmaalaha.
summary: Ma jiraan akoonno. Ma jiraan falanqaynyo. Ma jiraan raadraac.
Faylalkaaga iyo wax-beddelkaagu waxay ku harayaan qalabkaaga ilaa aad doorato inaad ku xirto server-kaaga Ollama.
Haddii aad isticmaasho Ollama, qoraalka waxaa loo diraa oo kaliya cinwaanka server-ka aad habaystay.

sections.title: Ururinta Macluumaadka
body: App-ku ma ururiyo, ma kaydiyo, mana gudbiyo macluumaadka shakhsiga ah server-yadayada.
Sawirrada shaashadda, shimikooyinka, iyo sawirrada la dhoofiyay waxaa lagu abuuraa laguna kaydiyaa qalabkaaga.

sections.title: Helitaanka Faylalka iyo Sawirrada
body: App-ku wuxuu codsan karaa inuu galo app-ka Faylalka ama maktabadda sawirradaada si uu u soo dejiyo sawirrada shaashadda.
Sawirrada la soo dejiyay waxaa lagu habaynayaa qalabka dhexdiisa, loomana gudbinayo si otomaatig ah.

sections.title: Turjumaada AI (Ollama)
body: Haddii aad u shiddo soo saarista qoraalka AI ama turjumaada, App-ku wuxuu qoraalka u diri karaa server-ka Ollama ee aad adigu habaystay (tusaale ahaan, kombiyuutarkaaga).
Ma maamulno mana helno xogtaada Ollama, App-kuna ma diwaangeliyo mana kaydiyo qoraalka ay AI-du habayso.

sections.title: Adeegyada Dhinac Saddexaad
body: App-ku ma isticmaalo falanqaynta dhinaca saddexaad, SDK-yada xayaysiinta, ama tignoolajiyada raadraaca.

sections.title: Isbeddellada
body: Waxaan kordhin karnaa Siyaasaddan Qarsoodiga ah mar walba. Isbeddellada waxaa lagu soo bandhigi doonaa boggan.

sections.title: Xiriirka
body: Haddii aad qabto su'aalo ku saabsan Siyaasaddan Khaaska ah, fadlan nagala soo xiriir iimaylka lagu bixiyay liiska App Store-ka.
